description:
MetalNode is one Mac running the metal-agent, joined to the cluster. The
admin creates it (with its ServiceAccount and Lease); the agent reports
through the Lease; the controller fills status and verifies the Mac is
reachable with a dial-back.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description:
MetalNodeSpec is written by the cluster admin (llmkube metal token create).
The agent has no write access to it.

hostIP.description:
HostIP is an address the admin knows reaches this Mac. It is tried
before the agent's own candidates and is still verified by the
dial-back; it is never trusted on its own.
The controller validates it (Reachable=False, reason InvalidSpec, when
it is not an IP address) rather than a CEL rule, whose isIP() would
need Kubernetes 1.31.

leaseName.description:
LeaseName is the coordination.k8s.io Lease, in this namespace, that the
agent renews as its heartbeat and annotates with its report.

serviceAccountName.description:
ServiceAccountName is the ServiceAccount the Mac's agent authenticates
as. Deleting that ServiceAccount revokes every token the agent holds.

verifier.description:
Verifier places the dial-back verifier pod. Point it at the nodes the
relay pods for this Mac run on, so the check tests the network path
the relay will use.

nodeSelector.description: NodeSelector is copied to the verifier pod.

tolerations.description: Tolerations are copied to the verifier pod.

items.description:
The pod this Toleration is attached to tolerates any taint that matches
the triple <key,value,effect> using the matching operator <operator>.

effect.description:
Effect indicates the taint effect to match. Empty means match all taint effects.
When specified, allowed values are NoSchedule, PreferNoSchedule and NoExecute.

key.description:
Key is the taint key that the toleration applies to. Empty means match all taint keys.
If the key is empty, operator must be Exists; this combination means to match all values and all keys.

operator.description:
Operator represents a key's relationship to the value.
Valid operators are Exists, Equal, Lt, and Gt. Defaults to Equal.
Exists is equivalent to wildcard for value, so that a pod can
tolerate all taints of a particular category.
Lt and Gt perform numeric comparisons (requires feature gate TaintTolerationComparisonOperators).

tolerationSeconds.description:
TolerationSeconds represents the period of time the toleration (which must be
of effect NoExecute, otherwise this field is ignored) tolerates the taint. By default,
it is not set, which means tolerate the taint forever (do not evict). Zero and
negative values will be treated as 0 (evict immediately) by the system.

value.description:
Value is the taint value the toleration matches to.
If the operator is Exists, the value should be empty, otherwise just a regular string.

status.description: MetalNodeStatus is written only by the controller.

agentVersion.description: AgentVersion is the version the agent reports.

candidates.description:
Candidates are the addresses tried, in preference order, with the last
dial-back result for each.

items.description: MetalNodeCandidate is one address and what the last dial-back found there.

checkedAt.description: CheckedAt is when the verifier finished the check that produced Result.

source.description:
Source says where the address came from: override (spec.hostIP or the
agent's --host-ip), tailnet, lan or docker-host.

capacity.description: Capacity is the hardware the agent reports.

chip.description: Chip is the CPU brand string (for example "Apple M5 Max").

gpuCores.description: GPUCores is the GPU core count.

memory.description: Memory is MemoryBytes as a quantity (for example 128Gi), for display.

memoryBytes.description: MemoryBytes is the Mac's unified memory in bytes.

metalVersion.description: MetalVersion is the Metal family the GPU supports (for example "Metal 4").

items.description: Condition contains details for one aspect of the current state of this API Resource.

lastTransitionTime.description:
lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.
This should be when the underlying condition changed.  If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable.

message.description:
message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition.
This may be an empty string.

observedGeneration.description:
observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon.
For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date
with respect to the current state of the instance.

reason.description:
reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition.
Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field,
and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API.
The value should be a CamelCase string.
This field may not be empty.

status.description: status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown.

type.description: type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase.

hostIP.description:
HostIP is the first candidate the dial-back verified. It is set only
while Reachable is True.

ingressPort.description: IngressPort is the agent's TLS ingress port.

ingressSPKI.description:
IngressSPKI is the base64 SHA-256 digest of the agent ingress
certificate's public key, as the agent reports it. The dial-back and
the relay complete TLS only against this key.

lastHeartbeatTime.description:
LastHeartbeatTime is the Lease's renewTime, accurate to about a
minute: it advances when AgentConnected changes or when it is more
than 60 seconds behind. The Lease holds the exact time.

observedGeneration.description: ObservedGeneration is the spec generation this status reflects.

consecutiveFailures.description:
ConsecutiveFailures counts checks in a row that verified no address;
it sets the retry backoff.

inputHash.description:
InputHash identifies the pin, port, candidate list and verifier
placement the last completed check ran against. A change starts a new
check.

lastCheckTime.description: LastCheckTime is when the last completed check finished.

lastStartTime.description:
LastStartTime is when the controller last started a verifier pod.
Starts are at least 30 seconds apart, whatever the Mac reports.

podUID.description:
PodUID is the UID of the verifier pod the controller last created.
Only that pod's results are read.
